question: For each number, what is printed directly in front of the boxed note: sharp, flat, natural, or none?
verbatim: Tile 1 is the third of 3 8 notes, the beam, but in front of the first of them is a sharp. But there's not anything right in front of the note. Tile 2 has a flat. Tile 3, similarly, is the third of 4 eighth notes. In front of the first of those, applying to all of them, is a natural sign. 4 natural. 5 natural, 6 natural, 7 sharp, 8 natural, 9 natural, 10 natural, 11 natural, 12 flat, 13 natural, 14 sharp, 15 sharp, 16 nothing, 17 natural, 18 sharp, 19 nothing, 20 natural, 21 natural, 22 flat, 23 sharp, 24 sharp.

answers.1: none directly in front (third of 3 beamed eighths; a sharp stands in front of the first of them)
answers.3: none directly in front (third of 4 eighths; a natural in front of the first applies to all of them)

wrong.6: Sean natural; file Bb4 (strokes read flat, no detector box)
wrong.8: Sean natural; file Ab5 (strokes flat AND detector flat)
wrong.9: Sean natural; file Ab5 (strokes flat AND detector flat)

sign_read_where_none_is_printed.16: file Ab3 with a flat read in front; Sean: nothing. Pitch unaffected (A-flat is in the key).

compared_with_the_file.ours: Comparison is OURS: the file's pitch read against Sean's sign in a three-flat key. All three errors are a natural read as a flat; in two of them both readings of the same ink (strokes and detector) agreed and were wrong together.
